# nah_disk_attachment (Data Source)

Reads a NahCloud disk_attachment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nah_disk_attachment" "data" {
  project = "my-app"
  disk_id = "DISK_ID"
  id      = "ATTACHMENT_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk_id` (String) Opaque parent disk ID.
- `id` (String) Opaque resource ID.
- `project` (String) Project slug.

### Read-Only

- `device` (String) Device name.
- `instance_id` (String) Opaque instance ID.
- `project_id` (String) Opaque owning project ID.
